security_risk: Existing document void SECURITY DEFINER could distinguish foreign document UUID from missing document UUID before jurisdiction check.
safe_alternative: REVOKE EXECUTE on public.void_document_issuance(uuid,text) FROM authenticated
operational_limitations: Temporarily disables direct document voiding by logged-in users, does not modify the vulnerable SQL body, and service_role retains EXECUTE. Re-enable only after V246 code is approved, installed and real cross-diocese and authorized void flows pass.
